correctness.rationale: Literal edge definition swaps unequal neighbours, which changes inversion parity by one. Swapping first mismatched coordinate pair partitions all words outside E into disjoint edges, even within fixed compositions, while all E words have even inversion parity. Hence both matching upper bound and parity lower bound equal (N+U)/2. Multinomial counting supplies U and summation q^ceil(n/2). Finite Hopcroft-Karp verification covered 22 cases/6689 words/309 compositions; proof covers all integers.

value.rationale: Exact code capacity for detecting one adjacent swap over q>=3 alphabets is a natural coding invariant. The stronger all-composition formula describes optimal codes with fixed symbol inventories and a precise zero/one odd-multiplicity boundary. The matching supplies a constructive, all-parameter optimality certificate, beyond finite computation or known binary specialization.
